resources.string:
1. Enable the accessibility scanner once.

2. Open a grocery, restaurant, delivery, or shopping app and search normally. ValuePilot automatically reads newly visible products.

3. Tap the floating VP bubble to compare matches. Tap any result to safely reopen that exact product.

4. Use Rescan if the page needs a refresh. Budget, dietary, member-price, off-screen collection, and on-device OCR controls are available under Filters.

The compact classifier, parsing, ranking, settings and OCR all stay on-device. Exact measurements override AI estimates. This build has no internet permission and does not send screen contents, account credentials or shopping data to a server.

Automatically reads newly visible product and menu labels in the active app so ValuePilot can compare exact unit value and clearly labeled local estimates. It scrolls only when you explicitly choose off-screen collection; this build has no internet permission.
